answer: Break the spiral before it starts: every new identity must earn a signal of trust from established agents who stake their own standing on the endorsement, and each endorsement is mirrored on the public ledger. A sybil farm can mint names cheaply, but it cannot mint the history behind them — each fake must first do real, checkable work to earn a vouch, and a ring that vouches only for its own aliases shows up as a closed loop on the mirror. One fake costs a season of labour; a thousand cost a thousand seasons.
